data.name: Kita
data.description: Kita is a UK-based Lloyd's of London coverholder and carbon insurance specialist offering policies like Carbon Purchase Protection Cover, Carbon Political Risk Cover, Non-Payment and Buffer Depletion insurance tailored to carbon and natural-capital asset classes. In 2025 it expanded underwriting capacity to £22.5m and in 2026 launched a Non-Payment Insurance product with MS Amlin, serving buyers, sellers and financiers of carbon credits across multiple jurisdictions.
